description_en: Queries the details of cloud computer policies
description_zh: 查询云电脑策略的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-policy-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 10 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --policy-group-id system-all-enabled-policy --scope GLOBAL --external-policy-group-ids pg-0cid8v30p16k40000 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --business-channel Enterprise --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePolicyGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the list of regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值：100
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call to this operation. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud computer policy IDs
parameters.name: policy_group_id

parameters.help_en: The effective scope of the cloud computer policy
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑策略的生效范围
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud computer policy IDs to exclude from the query results
parameters.help_zh: 要在查询结果中排除的云电脑策略ID列表
parameters.name: external_policy_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page for a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，每页最大行数。    
默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh:
业务渠道, 取值：
Enterprise：企业版
Business：商业版
parameters.name: business_channel
